title: My Sister Forged The Deed, Sold Dad's Farm For $690K, And Left Me $4,900. So I Voided The Sale
description: At 59, after 27 years as a school custodian, I returned to care for my dying father. My sister forged the deed, sold his 40-acre tree farm for $690,000, and left me a $4,900 wreath check. Then I found the original will hidden in a tin sap bucket and voided the sale. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #InheritanceDrama
thumb_text: SHE SOLD DAD'S FARM. I FOUND THE WILL.
pinned_comment: If your sister forged your father's deed, sold his 40-acre Christmas tree farm for $690K, and handed you a $4,900 wreath check, would you have let her keep pruning trees in that smock or turned her in the moment you found the real will? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: DAD LEFT ME 60% AND SHE LEFT ME A $4,900 WREATH CHECK
